children: JustLend DAO completed its fifth JST buyback and burn on 17 Oct 2026. The round permanently burned 170,723,144 JST, equal to 1.72% of the token's total supply. The estimated value of the tokens burned was about $23.53 million.
The burn directly reduces JST's circulating supply and supports its deflationary setup. As part of a recurring program, the round is unlikely to surprise the market.
Five rounds of execution, with every burn verifiable on-chain.

title: JUST: JustLend DAO completes fifth JST buyback and burn - 17 Oct 2026
